description: The bar chart illustrates the performance comparison between two models, MMAU and MMAR, across three distinct audio reasoning benchmarks: Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen2.5-Omni, with accuracy measured as a percentage on the vertical axis ranging from 0 to 70%. The horizontal axis lists the three benchmarks in order from left to right. For each benchmark, two adjacent bars represent the respective model’s accuracy: MMAU is shown in dark blue and MMAR in purple. On Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, MMAU achieves approximately 49% accuracy while MMAR reaches about 30%. On Audio-Reasoner, MMAU scores around 61% and MMAR about 36%. On Qwen2.5-Omni, MMAU attains roughly 65% accuracy, and MMAR reaches approximately 56%. Across all three benchmarks, MMAU consistently outperforms MMAR, with the largest performance gap observed on Qwen2-Audio-Instruct and the smallest on Qwen2.5-Omni. The chart includes a legend in the upper left corner identifying the color coding for each model. The bars are grouped by benchmark, with no stacking, and are presented in a clean, uncluttered layout with clear axis labels and tick marks at 10% intervals.
